page.content:
Claude Aradel is the current Governor of Elendel on Scadrial, preceded by Replar Innate. He previously served as a constable in Elendel, attaining the rank of constable-general.

page.overview:
Who is Claude Aradel?

Claude Aradel is the current Governor of Elendel on Scadrial, preceded by Replar Innate. He previously served as a constable in Elendel, attaining the rank of constable-general.
